title: Lesson file
description: corpus/lessons/<lang>.json: the >= 20 Learn lessons (spec section 7, F32). `body` is a list of paragraphs totalling 350-450 words (a five-minute read) and may contain only the `{placeholders}` listed under `placeholders` below; the app resolves each from the reader's own ChartData / dasha tree / panchang at birth (see packages/content/src/lessons.ts LESSON_PLACEHOLDERS for the resolver contract). `terms` are glossary ids linked from the lesson (every one must exist in corpus/glossary). `tryIt` is the 'Try it on your chart' row: an expo-router `route` inside the app and the ui key (`label`) of the card it opens. `unlocksLevel` is the corpus snippet level (2 or 3) that 'Mark done' unlocks for the Why? sheets; lessons never unlock anything commercial.

placeholders.name: The reader's profile name.
placeholders.moonSign: Sidereal Moon sign name in the UI language (ChartData.planets Mo.sign).
placeholders.moonSignLord: Lord of the Moon sign (planet name).
placeholders.lagna: Lagna sign name, or the UI string lesson.lagnaUnknown when the birth time is unknown (ChartData.lagna).
placeholders.lagnaLord: Lord of the Lagna sign, or lesson.lagnaUnknown when unknown.
placeholders.nakshatraLord: Vimshottari lord of the birth nakshatra (planet name).
placeholders.mahaEnds: Date the running mahadasha ends, formatted in the profile time zone.
placeholders.antarEnds: Date the running antardasha ends, formatted.
placeholders.balanceYears: Balance of that dasha at birth in years, one decimal.
placeholders.saturnHouseFromMoon: Saturn's natal sign counted from the Moon sign, 1-12.
placeholders.saturnHouse: Saturn's natal whole-sign house from the first-house sign, 1-12 (Sa.house).
placeholders.moonHouse: Moon's natal house 1-12 (Mo.house; 1 in Moon-chart mode).
placeholders.moonDegree: Moon's degree inside its sign, whole degrees (Mo.degree).
placeholders.moonNavamsaSign: Moon's sign in the D9 (varga(chart,'D9') Mo.sign).
placeholders.lagnaNavamsaSign: Lagna sign in the D9, or lesson.lagnaUnknown.
placeholders.tenthLord: Lord of the 10th house (houses[9].lord), counted from the first-house sign.
placeholders.birthTithi: Tithi name at birth (panchang at birth).
placeholders.birthVara: Weekday name of the birth day in the UI language.
placeholders.ayanamsa: Ayanamsa name from settings (meta.ayanamsa, Lahiri by default).
placeholders.ayanamsaDegrees: Ayanamsa value at birth in degrees, two decimals (meta.ayanamsaDegrees).
placeholders.nodeMode: Node mode from settings (mean or true) as the UI string.
placeholders.todayMoonSign: Today's Moon sign name at the profile place.
placeholders.todayMoonHouseFromMoon: Today's Moon sign counted from the birth Moon sign, 1-12.
placeholders.todayTara: Today's Tara bala name (Janma ... Param Mitra).
placeholders.rahuKaalToday: Today's Rahu Kaal as a start-end range in the profile time zone.
placeholders.sunriseToday: Today's sunrise time at the profile place.
placeholders.sunsetToday: Today's sunset time at the profile place.
placeholders.nextJanmaTithi: Date of the reader's next janma tithi (tithiEventDates), formatted.
placeholders.savLagna: Sarvashtakavarga bindus of the first house (ashtakavarga(chart).sav[0]).
placeholders.yogaCount: Number of formed yogas in the chart (yogas(chart) formed && !cancelledBy).
placeholders.firstYoga: Name of the first formed yoga, or lesson.noYoga when none.
placeholders.kpLagnaSubLord: KP sub-lord of the Lagna cusp, or lesson.lagnaUnknown when the time is unknown.
